Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The Body Appreciation Scale (BAS, Avalos, Tylka, & Wood-Barcalow, 2005) was included as a positive measure of body image.

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: BMI was calculated using self-reported height and weight.

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section lists instruments used: EMI-2 for exercise goals, BREQ-2 for exercise regulation, PASTAS and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and the Self-Discrepancy Index (SDI) for body image, and the LTEQ for physical activity. BMI was calculated from self-reported height and weight. The section does not label any study (no 'Study 1' etc.) and provides no information on sample size, country, demographics, or correlations between BAS and BMI.
